paper.title: Algorithm 762: LLDRLF, log-likelihood and some derivatives for log-F models
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 22(3), 372-382 (1996); collected as ACM TOMS Algorithm 762
paper.note: ACM article not read; the authors' Fortran (netlib TOMS 762.gz, sha256 checked) was run.

field: numerics (special functions and statistics: log-F likelihood)
stack: Fortran (double precision sources from netlib TOMS 762); built with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox

claim.text: log(f(exp(W)|DFN,DFD)) at W = -1000 standard deviations, A = B = 1e-3, as printed by LLDRLF through the authors' driver1.f (shipped RES1, first block, line 'log(f(exp(W)|DFN,DFD))'). Registered tolerance: abs 1e-6.

build_commands: gfortran -O2 -o tstsht driver1.o src.o others.o port.o

attempt: Ran the authors' double-precision sources (Src/Dp/src.f, others.f, port.f and Drivers/Dp/driver1.f, unpacked verbatim from the archive, no source edit) with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 -O2 in the sandbox, built as tstsht. The driver is interactive; stdin answers were no (stdout), no (A,B grid), no (W grid), then blank lines for PAUSE and no to continue (evidence/stdin is generated by the recipe). Two passes in fresh run directories print log(f(exp(W)|DFN,DFD)) at W=-1000, A=B=1e-3 = -1.4180151734062165E+03 in both, identical to the registered paper value and to the shipped RES1 to all 17 printed digits (difference 0, inside tol_abs 1e-6). The value is computed by the code, not echoed from its input. The build is build-only: the five build commands compile the unmodified sources (manifest pre = mid, 5 files compared, nothing modified, removed or added).

original_attempt.reason: The archive ships no makefile and no build instructions. The sandbox as shipped has no Fortran compiler on PATH (no gfortran, f77 or g77), so no build could start (exit 127). Retry with gfortran 16 installed into the sandbox (fetch step, micromamba, compiler only) compiled the unmodified sources with exit 0.
